'''Tannis''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Omwati/Legends|Omwati]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]].

==Biography==
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Omwati/Legends|Omwati]], Tannis was [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] after being located on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Ascending to the rank of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]], Tannis was appointed as [[Headmaster/Legends|Headmistress]] of the [[Teyan Praxeum]], a [[Jedi academy]] on the planet [[Teya IV]]. A proponent of initiating all Forceful [[Sentience/Legends|sentients]] within the Order, Tannis served as a [[Jedi recruiter|recruiter]] and often traveled the galaxy to find new students to train with her on Teya IV. During her travels to [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] in [[4000 BBY/Legends|4000 BBY]], Tannis discovered a family with two Forceful children living near [[Lir Lake]]. Testing both [[Vici Ramunee|Vici]] and [[Veni Ramunee]], she deemed them eligible for Jedi training and took them to the Teyan Academy to learn the ways of the Jedi.<ref name="TMDF" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tannis's appearance at first seemed a continuity error, since the Omwati were not supposed to be discovered until [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin's]] lifetime. ''[[Alien Anthology]]'' retconned this by explaining that a mysterious Omwati colony was established on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] long before Tarkin discovered [[Omwat/Legends|Omwat]]. How the colony came to be there is uncertain, but it may indicate the Omwati had contact with the galactic community prior to the [[Old Sith Wars]].
